Synthetic epilepsy clinic letter, 14 March 2026.

I reviewed Ms Hale in clinic today. Her typical pattern remains two focal seizures a month. She has had five seizures so far this year. She continues levetiracetam 500 mg twice daily.

Synthetic epilepsy clinic letter, 12 June 2026.

I reviewed Mr Cole today. He has remained seizure-free since September 2025 on lamotrigine 150 mg twice daily. MRI brain was normal.

Synthetic epilepsy clinic letter, 3 April 2026.

I reviewed Ms Reid today. She continues carbamazepine 200 mg twice daily and reports no side effects. MRI brain and EEG were unchanged. Follow-up in six months.
